description: Fetches the latest snapshot or a requested snapshot id in JSON or Markdown. The export payload is passed through byte-identical. Handoffs are immutable and additive-only within agent-context/v1; execution packages carry approved work out and regeneration results carry proposed artifacts back. feedback_type and severity are reserved/non-normative, so consumers must not branch on them.

snapshot_id.description: Immutable snapshot id; latest when omitted.

name: get_handoff
